metadata.title: Ascending, Bridge, and Unknotting Numbers of Knotted Graphs
metadata.abstract: In this paper we define the ascending number and bridge number for virtual and welded spatial graphs. We prove that the former admits a lower bound in terms of the latter. This relationship allows us to compare different notions of unknotting virtual spatial graphs by crossing changes.
